description: Fetch one Handshakr supplier an AI agent may read, by slug. `contactable` says whether the supplier has switched agent access on and may be approached. `description` and `category` are the company's own words or null; text Handshakr wrote from public sources is in `handshakr_summary` / `handshakr_category`, labelled, and is not a fact about the company. `trust_score` is null: no score is computed. `trading_name_of`, when not null, names the registered company this listing is a trading name of (legal name, company number, the passport holding its Companies House record): listings that share a company number there are one company, not several. `verifiable_record` is the latest signed, append-only version of the public passport: its version, sha256, log position, and where to fetch the W3C Verifiable Credential and its status.
name: get_seller
title: Get seller
